description: The drain near the market has been blocked for days and water is collecting on the road.
The drainage channel beside the market has not been cleared and the road is flooding.
Water is collecting because the drain is blocked near the market.
Rubbish has piled up at the trading centre and nobody has collected it.
Garbage has not been collected at the trading centre for two weeks and it smells.
A pothole is making the road difficult to use for boda bodas.
There is a broken public tap near the trading centre.
Open drain overflowing near the primary school, children walk through dirty water.
Heap of rubbish burning near the market stalls.
The street lights on the main road do not work.
